meetings.title: 1st Meeting 2024
meetings.summary: In today's meeting, appointment of the Committee chair and Deputy chair of the committee was scheduled. Senior Officer Shifna Ali presided over the selection process of committee's chairperson and vice chairperson. Faresmaathodaa Constituency Member Ashraf Rasheed proposed to elect Thoddoo Constituency Member Hussain Sameer as the Chair of the Committee. It was seconded by Gan Constituency Member Yoosuf Nasheed. Below are the vote details of the appointment. Vote: To elect Thoddoo Constituency Member Hussain Sameer as the Chair of the Committee Total number of members: 04 Number of members present: 04 Voted Yes: 04 Voted against 0 Abstain: 0 Required to Pass: 03 Result: Passed Hence, Thoddoo Constituency Member Hussain Sameer was elected as the Chair of the Committee. Then, Faresmaathodaa Constituency Member Ashraf Rasheed proposed to elect Kinbidhoo Constituency Member Ali Ashrag as the Vice Chair of the Committee. It was seconded by Thohdooo Constituency Member Hussain Sameer. Below are the vote details of the appointment. Vote: To elect Kinbidhoo Constituency Member Ali Ashrag as the Vice Chair of the Committee Total number of members: 04 Number of members present: 04 Voted Yes: 04 Voted against 0 Abstain: 0 Required to Pass: 03 Result: Passed Hence, Kinbidhoo Constituency Member Ali Ashrag was elected as the Vice Chair of the Committee. For a last thing, Kinbidhoo Constituency Member Ali Ashrag proposed the committee quorum as 3 members, which was seconded by Faresmaathodaa Constituency Member Ashraf Rasheed. Below are the vote details of the appointment. Vote: To decide the committe quorum as 3 members. Total number of members: 04 Number of members present: 04 Voted Yes: 04 Voted against 0 Abstain: 0 Required to Pass: 02 Result: Passed Hence, the committee quorum was decided to be 3 members. It was also decided to review the reports prepared by the Privatization and Corporatization Board on companies in the committee's domain.
